Use when asked "prove the claims on this page", replace thin SEO copy with traceable examples, or route a changed benchmark, approved quote, or product fact to every page that uses it. NOT FOR: collecting new interviews (suede-customer-research) or writing finished copy (suede-copy).

skills.name: Suede SEO Sprint Skills
skills.description: Use when asked "run an SEO sprint on this page" or to prioritize a month of work for one high-value landing page and query cluster. Establish a search and conversion baseline, stage changes, and verify outcomes. NOT FOR: site-wide diagnosis (use suede-seo-audit) or a broad publishing calendar (use suede-content-strategy).

skills.name: Suede SERP Research Skills
skills.description: Use when asked "cluster keywords by live SERP overlap" or to research query intent, result composition, and citations from comparable returned results. Turn the observations into defensible URL mapping. NOT FOR: drafting comparison pages (use suede-competitors) or a full prompt-panel program (use suede-ai-seo).

skills.name: Suede Ship Copy Skills
skills.description: Produce one high-stakes public draft with parallel research, agent-claim audits, message ownership, adversarial review, publish readiness, and an evidence record. Use when asked to "research and draft this launch page" or rigorously develop one landing page, email, post, README, ad, or store listing. Preserves requester-supplied facts and writes drafts only. NOT FOR: routine or bulk copy (use suede-copy), code changes (use suede-graph-flo-xr), or cleaning existing prose (use suede-deslop).

skills.name: Suede Site Alchemy Skills
skills.description: Turn landing, launch, campaign, and product pages into measured conversion paths: funnel stage, friction, hero, proof, CTAs, pricing, mobile QA, and pre-registered experiments. Use when asked to "fix this page that gets no signups" or improve demos and sales from existing traffic. Implements and verifies changes within scope. NOT FOR: SEO scores (use suede-seo-audit), AI citations (use suede-ai-seo), promotion grades (use suede-visibility-grader), or copy alone (use suede-copy).

skills.name: Suede SMS Skills
skills.description: Design consent-aware SMS/MMS programs: channel fit, welcome, cart recovery, post-purchase and win-back flows, exact copy, segment counts, cadence, quiet hours, platform selection, and measurement. Use when asked to "draft our SMS welcome flow" or audit a text program. Checks current consent, opt-out, and registration requirements. NOT FOR: email (use suede-emails), capture UX (use suede-site-alchemy), legal certification, or sending, scheduling, importing, or registering anything.

skills.name: Suede Social Skills
skills.description: Plan, audit, and draft organic social for founder/brand accounts: platform mix, 30-post audits, calendars, Instagram, LinkedIn/X, short-video scripts, social search, and listening. Use when asked to "audit our Instagram growth" or build an approval-ready content loop. NOT FOR: paid ads (use suede-ads or suede-ad-creative), editorial agents (use suede-newsroom), clip-to-guide work (use suede-clip-to-guide), video rendering (use suede-video), or broad content strategy (use suede-content-strategy).

skills.name: Suede Sync Packaging Skills
skills.description: Prepare a song for sync review: scene fit, supervisor one-sheet, asset checklist, lyric flags, mood tags, AI disclosure, and open clearance questions. Use when asked to "make a sync one-sheet" or package a track for film, TV, ads, games, trailers, or creator campaigns. Drafts pitch materials with open clearance questions labeled. NOT FOR: rights investigations or transfer packages (use suede-rights-passport), folder linting (use suede-release-linter), or rollouts (use suede-campaign-in-a-box).

skills.name: Suede Syndication Skills
skills.description: Adapt an owned launch, benchmark or report to external publications with rights, privacy checks and canonical decisions. Use when asked "Adapt our benchmark for three publications." Return review-ready, channel-specific packets. NOT FOR: journalist relationships (use suede-public-relations) or editorial team design (use suede-newsroom).

skills.name: Suede Video Skills
skills.description: Plan or produce marketing video with scripts, storyboards, shot and asset lists, consent-aware AI or avatar choices, programmatic rendering, edit decisions, pacing, export specs, and video-search metadata. Use when asked to "turn this demo into a short video" or build a repeatable production pipeline. NOT FOR: social calendars (use suede-social), clip-to-guide bridges (use suede-clip-to-guide), paid ad concepts (use suede-ad-creative), still images (use suede-image), or unapproved publishing.

skills.name: Suede Visibility Grader Skills
skills.description: Grade one public page A-F across findability, first-screen clarity, CTA pull, proof and trust, AI citation readiness, and design signal, with up to five ranked fixes. Use when asked to "grade this page before promotion" or give a quick readiness check of a landing page, README, docs, or campaign. NOT FOR: deep SEO and schema audits (use suede-seo-audit), AI crawler/citation measurement (use suede-ai-seo), or implementing conversion changes (use suede-site-alchemy).

skills.name: Suede Workflow Skills
skills.description: Route requests across the full public Suede pack to the narrowest specialist and preserve the request verbatim. Use when asked "which Suede skill should I use?", when work crosses lanes, or when only the umbrella is installed. For next-action help: what’s next, recommend the next move, give me the prompt, expand prompt, or make it granular. NOT FOR: one clear lane (use its specialist), one multi-file implementation graph (use suede-graph-flo-xr), or parallel file ownership (use suede-agent-teams).
